nodes.name: Daily 04:00
nodes.notes: 04:00 Europe/Lisbon (GENERIC_TIMEZONE), one hour after backup.sh at 03:00 so a bad night shows both signals together.

nodes.name: PingSupabase
nodes.notes: onError=continueRegularOutput is load-bearing: a Supabase auto-pause removes the project's DNS record, which is a TRANSPORT error. neverError does not cover those, so without this the node throws and the alert never fires -- for exactly the failure it exists to catch.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value: =Ryvo ALERT: Supabase keepalive FAILED ({{ $('PingSupabase').first().json.statusCode || 'no response - DNS or connection failure' }}). The platform DB is unreachable, so inbound leads are not being stored. Email alert: {{ $('AssertEmailSent').first().json.emailOk ? 'sent' : 'NOT SENT' }}. Check the Supabase dashboard for an auto-pause.

nodes.name: NotifyKeepaliveFailure
nodes.notes: Reads $('PingSupabase') explicitly, never $json. Inserting the email nodes upstream silently repointed $json at the EMAIL provider's response, so this alert reported 'keepalive FAILED (200)' - the status of the thing that WORKED. A positional reference survives only until someone inserts a node.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ from: "alerts@ryvodigital.com", to: ["manuel.seixasvale@gmail.com", "hello@ryvodigital.com"], subject: 'Ryvo ALERT: Supabase keepalive FAILED', text: 'The daily Supabase keepalive could not reach the platform database.

' + 'Status: ' + ($json.statusCode || 'no response - DNS or connection failure') + '
' + 'At: ' + new Date().toISOString() + '

' + 'Inbound leads are not being stored while this is true. The free tier auto-pauses after about a week of inactivity, which also removes the DNS record - check the Supabase dashboard first.' }) }}

nodes.name: EmailKeepaliveFailure
nodes.notes: Email runs BEFORE the WhatsApp push, because it is the leg that does not expire. The sandbox session dies every 72 hours; this one does not. Addresses are hardcoded on purpose - an alert target read from the monitored system is gone when it is needed.

nodes.name: AssertEmailSent
nodes.notes: A send that was not accepted must not look like one that was.
